# Grit + Grace Doula

> Compassionate, nonmedical doula support for pregnancy, birth, postpartum, breastfeeding education, and newborn care in Orange County, California.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/): An overview of doula support and ways to begin.
- [Services](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/services/): Prenatal, birth, postpartum, breastfeeding education, and newborn-care support.
- [About](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/about/): Teesee Logan’s background, approach, and qualifications.
- [Book a consultation](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/book/): Schedule a complimentary 30-minute consultation.
- [Contact](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/contact/): Send a general inquiry or use direct contact details.

## Resources

- [Resource library](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/resources/): Practical guidance for pregnancy, birth, and early parenthood.
- [Guides](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/resources/guides/): Downloadable guides.
- [The Journal](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/resources/blog/): Educational articles about doula care and family support.
- [Client experiences](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/testimonials/): Experiences shared with permission.

## Service detail pages

- [Prenatal support](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/services/prenatal/)
- [Birth support](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/services/birth/)
- [Postpartum care](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/services/postpartum/)
- [Breastfeeding education](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/services/breastfeeding/)
- [Newborn care](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/services/newborn-care/)

## Scope

Information on this site is educational and nonmedical. It does not replace advice from a licensed healthcare professional.
